original_hook: Privacy coins usually carry a heavy regulatory discount, but $ZEC just absorbed $816M in USDT volume following two structural catalysts: Paradigm disclosing a ZEC stake and Zcash miner Fortitude hiring former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton ahead of a public listing. The 1H chart shows hourly volume expanding to 38,076 ZEC as price pushed to $1,491. Notice what happened next: volume dropped 50% to 17,811 ZEC, yet price held tightly above $1,452. That tight range on declining volume signals seller depletion rather than distribution. A 1H close holding the $1,452–$1,470 shelf on expanding volume keeps the impulse alive. Invalidation drops below $1,423 (breakout origin). 📊 ZEC 1H: price $1471.09 • support $1234.32 • resistance $1491 • TP1 $1555.17 • target $1619.34 • SL / invalidation $1234.32 (long bias). Levels are chart-derived scenarios, not guarantees. What confirmation on $ZEC would make you treat this setup as real rather than an early headline move?
